A row nested directly inside a cell keeps its visible text

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<table><tr><td><tr><td>Visible text</td></tr></td></tr></table>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result$content)
```
